info.title: SoMerch Integrations API
info.description:
Public REST API for the SoMerch corporate merch platform. This specification documents every endpoint used by the official SoMerch Zapier app (OAuth 2.0, REST-hook triggers, polling triggers, choice/dropdown sources, and the central action dispatcher) as well as the resource and webhook management surface.

Base URL: https://somerch.co

The machine-readable version of this document is published at https://docs.somerch.co/openapi.json. Developer guides live in the SoMerch api-docs repository: https://github.com/SoMerch/api-docs

get.description: Browser endpoint that renders the SoMerch consent screen. Callers redirect the user here with the standard authorization code parameters (PKCE optional but recommended). On approval SoMerch issues a single-use code and redirects back to `redirect_uri` with `code` and `state`. Returns an HTML page, not JSON.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The OAuth client id registered for the integration.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: URI the user is redirected back to after approval or denial.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Space-delimited scopes requested (for example `orders:read catalog:read webhooks:write`).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque value echoed back in the redirect for CSRF protection.

302.description: Redirect to `redirect_uri` with `code` and `state` after consent, or with `error=access_denied` on denial.

400.description: Invalid request (missing client_id or redirect_uri, unsupported response_type).

post.description: Exchanges an authorization code for tokens or refreshes existing tokens. Supports `authorization_code` and `refresh_token` grants. Client credentials may be sent in the body or via HTTP Basic auth. Responses follow RFC 6749. Access tokens are valid for 8 hours; refresh tokens for 90 days and rotate on every use.

400.description: Invalid request (missing field, bad code or refresh token).

post.summary: Revoke an access or refresh token (RFC 7009)
post.description: Revokes a token so it can no longer be used. Always returns 200 for a well-formed request, even when the token is already unknown or revoked. Zapier calls this when a connection is deleted.

get.description: Returns the organization and (when present) user the token resolves to, the scopes granted to the token, and a human label. Zapier calls this right after the OAuth handshake to label the connection and to verify the token is still valid.
Catalog of provider slugs the platform knows about (zapier, chatgpt-mcp, generic-webhook, and so on) with their status and supported integrations.

parameters.name: include_planned
parameters.description: Include providers that are not yet available for installation.

get.description: Sanitized list of the connection records for the caller's organization. Credential material is never returned.

post.summary: Create or update an integration connection
post.description: Attach a provider connection stub to the caller's organization. Hosted providers normally connect through the OAuth flow at /oauth/authorize instead.

get.description: Fetch a single connection by id, scoped to the caller's organization.

delete.description: Soft-disconnects the connection (status becomes `disconnected`, credentials are cleared).

get.description: Filterable event log for the caller's organization. PII is redacted from event payloads before they are returned or delivered.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: created_at ISO cursor for pagination (returns older rows).

200.description: List of events with pagination cursor.

get.description: List the org's outgoing webhook subscriptions.

post.description: Register a URL to receive signed deliveries for the requested event types. The signing secret is returned exactly once, at creation time. The target URL is validated to prevent SSRF.

201.description: Subscription created. The `secret` is shown only once.

400.description: Invalid request or unsafe target URL.

patch.description: Toggle active state or update url / event_types / description of a single webhook, scoped to the caller's organization.

get.description: Inspect the org's background jobs (webhook deliveries, retries).
Cross-provider audit trail for the caller's organization. Credentials, tokens, and PII are redacted server-side.

get.summary: Event catalogue for Zapier REST hooks
get.description: Lists the event types a Zapier trigger can subscribe to together with the scope each one requires.

post.description: Registers a hook URL for one event type so SoMerch delivers webhooks to it. Requires `webhooks:write` plus the per-event scope. Returns the hook `id` so Zapier can unsubscribe later. The hook URL is validated to prevent SSRF.

400.description: Unsupported event type, missing URL, or unsafe hook URL.

403.description: Missing required scope (`webhooks:write` or the per-event scope).

delete.description: Deletes a hook subscription by id. Zapier calls this when a Zap using a REST-hook trigger is turned off or deleted. A 404 is tolerated and treated as success by Zapier.

get.description: Polling endpoint used by the Zapier 'New Order' and 'Order Status Changed' triggers as a fallback and for initial import. Returns the caller's organization's orders, newest first, without contact PII. Zapier dedupes on the top-level `id`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only return rows created after this ISO timestamp.

get.description: Polling endpoint used by the Zapier 'New Shipment' and 'Shipment Updated' triggers. Returns the caller's organization's shipments (resolved through the orders they belong to), newest first. Zapier dedupes on the top-level `id`.
Polling endpoint used by the Zapier 'New Quote Request' trigger. Returns the caller's organization's quote requests, newest first. Contact PII is omitted.
Dynamic dropdown source for product categories used by the Zapier 'Find Products' search. Requires `catalog:read`.
Dynamic dropdown source for order statuses used in Zapier filters. Requires `orders:read`.
Returns the organization(s) the connected token can act on. Used for connection labels and read-only display.
Lists every action key the central action dispatcher can invoke.

post.description:
Universal action dispatcher used by the SoMerch Zapier searches and creates. The body is `{ "input": <action input> }`, where the input shape depends on the action key (see `docs/actions.md`). Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make replays safe (24-hour TTL). Responses use the `ActionResult` envelope: `{ ok, data, error, correlation_id }`.

The full per-action input and output schemas are documented in `/docs/actions.md` and mirrored as component schemas below.

Available actions (SoMerch/Zapier):
- `system.ping`
- `orders.list`, `orders.get`
- `catalog.search_products`, `catalog.get_product`
- `quotes.submit`
- `plans.create`

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque key. Replays within 24 hours return the original response (with `X-Idempotent-Replay: true`).

400.description: Validation error or permanent (non-retryable) action failure.

403.description: Missing required scope for the action.

post.description: Endpoint SoMerch exposes for third parties to deliver webhooks to. SoMerch verifies the provider signature, normalizes the payload, enqueues a job, and returns a 2xx. Configure this URL on the provider side.
Internal, secret-gated cron entry point that drains `integration_webhook_deliveries` with exponential backoff. Not for direct external use.

get.description: Returns booleans and binding origins for each Supabase binding. Never returns secrets. Returns 503 when unhealthy.
Machine-readable description of this integrations API.

post.description: SoMerch's public MCP endpoint used by the ChatGPT plugin and other MCP clients. Discovered via /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json. Unauthenticated; provides catalog, planning, and quote tools.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: OAuth2 access token (sat_), API key (sk_), or Supabase JWT
bearerAuth.description: Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are obtained through the OAuth 2.0 flow (scopes below), long-lived org-scoped API keys issued in the SoMerch admin console (prefixed `sk_`), or Supabase-issued user JWT access tokens. Missing or invalid tokens return 401 with a `WWW-Authenticate` header pointing at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.

oauth2.description: Authorization Code grant with optional PKCE. Authorization endpoint: https://somerch.co/oauth/authorize. Token endpoint: https://somerch.co/api/public/v1/oauth2/token. Refresh tokens rotate on every use.

scopes.orders:read: Read your orders and their statuses
scopes.shipments:read: Read your shipments and tracking updates
scopes.quotes:read: Read quote requests submitted by your organization
scopes.quotes:write: Submit new quote requests on your behalf
scopes.catalog:read: Search the SoMerch product catalogue and pricing
scopes.webhooks:write: Create and remove webhook subscriptions (needed by Zaps)

code_verifier.description: Required when PKCE was used at the authorization endpoint.

input.description: Action-specific input. See the per-action schemas below (SystemPingInput, OrdersListInput, OrdersGetInput, ProductSearchInput, GetProductInput, QuotesSubmitInput, PlansCreateInput).

consent_terms.description: Must be true. Personal email addresses are rejected; repeats are idempotent by (plan, option, email).
